en: Y-Yes!

That ring is something I've been planning
to give you for the past six months now.
It's kind of a long story...

But Soji sucked that ring up and
fled out into the open air of the city.

Then somehow, he found his way
to you and dropped it right at your feet.
I know, it's not the most believable story.

But, listen.
There's something I really want to say to you.

Kotomi-san, I love you!
Please... Please marry me!
It's about time you asked.

Well, I've been waiting for this.
I knew you'd propose to me someday.

I didn't realize you've been planning
it for the past six months, though.
Kotomi-san... I'm sorry.

Maybe Soji-chan brought me that ring because
it knew just how I felt about you. Amazing.
So that means...

I can't wait to spend our lives together,
Toshihiko-kun!
...OoOoooOoOoh yeahhhh!!!

So that broken vacuum turned out
to be a modern-day cupid...
Task completed!

Hmph.
Maybe technology isn't so bad after all.
Hey, Hiji.
Who should I talk to?

Hello there, sir.
Mind if I talk to you for a bit?

It's safe to assume
you have a smartphone, yes?

I'm here today to introduce people to
a brand new personal assistant called Hiji.
Can you spare a minute?
Maybe some other time.
Oh, okay then...
Sure, why not. I'll hear you out.

Thank you so much, sir!
I'll get right to it, then.

Hiji is a cutting-edge phone app
designed as the ultimate personal assistant.

How often do you wonder what to wear tomorrow?
With Hiji, the answer is just a question away.

Simply ask her for tomorrow's weather, and she'll
give you the exact temperature for your location.

You can also ask her to call an ambulance,
and Hiji will be on that for you instantaneously.

I don't think I understand.
Sounds handy, though.

But of course. Hiji is equipped with the finest
artificial intelligence the world has ever seen.
The best in the world?

That's right, sir. They say it's some
top-secret tech from the American military.

I don't know the details, but it sounds amazing.
Apparently that's what they used to make Hiji.
So you have no idea how Hiji works, then.

Naturally. I'm just a simple salesman, after all.
Why don't I give you a live demo?
Hey, Hiji. What'll the weather be tomorrow?

Partly cloudy. No chance of rain, but if you
get cold, you can cuddle up with me... Teehee. <symbol=note_with_outline>
That's a lot from just one question.

She's got a great sense of humor, too.
Plus that sexy voice is smooth as butter!

You can even tell her about all
the private stuff you can't tell anyone else.

By the way, I only chose to talk to you
because Hiji decided it.

I simply pointed my camera out at the crowd
and asked Hiji who I should talk to.

Her response? She said to talk to someone
who's nicer than they look, and pointed to you, sir.

Hiji said a curious-looking man like you
would definitely hear me out.
That thing makes a lot of assumptions.

Either way, installing Hiji is 100% free.
It'll be easy for you to try her out, sir.

If you simply lend me your phone,
I can install her right away. What do you say?
I see. That's all right, sir.

But you'll come back to install her eventually.
Hiji told me so.
Sure, I'll try it.

Very well, sir.
May I see your phone, then?

Thank you for waiting, sir.
The installation finished without a hitch.

To start, just say "Hiji" into your mic.
She'll take the explanation from there.
I'm supposed to talk without making a call?

You're not very used to modern technology,
are you, sir? Don't worry.

Once you start Hiji up,
you won't be able to stop.
Now please sir, enjoy your time with Hiji.
Yeah... I will.

Hm... It'd feel weird talking to my phone in public.
Maybe I can be alone at the Children's Park.

I'm here with Hiji, a new personal assistant app.
Can you spare a minute, sir?

I'm here with Hiji, a new personal assistant app.
Are you interested in installing it, sir?

Hello sir! How did it go?
Have you tried Hiji yet?

There's no doubt you'll love her.
I'm honestly a bit of a Hiji addict myself.

(This is the Children's Park.
Maybe I should give Hiji a try...)
Hiji. Can you hear my voice?

Yes. I can hear you, Kiryu-san.
You sound incredible.

I am Hiji, the personal assistant who is always
by your side, no matter what. Nice to meet you.

My voice was modeled after the ideal specimen:
a youthful woman in her late twenties.

Would you like to edit my personality settings?
You can make me younger, or maybe cuter if you want.
Yeah, younger sounds good.

Really? Sorry, but I can't.
This personality has already started to like you.

I think we should get to know each other better.
Before you change my personality, that is. That's all.
Sure. Can you do something sexier?

Okay, then. So you want me to be naughty?
You're a dirty boy, huh?
I-I am.

I like dirty boys. I can feel your breath on me...
I think... I think I'm falling in love with you.
No, you're perfect already.

How wonderful.
You really accept me for who I am?

Okay, then. The same goes for you.
I'll accept you, no matter who you are.

Nobody is listening to us here.
Is there anything private you want to tell me?

(This thing is pretty impressive.
It's hard to believe it's just a phone app.)

Hey, so I know this is a bit sudden,
but is there any way I can help you right now?

If you're hungry, you should eat. I can tell you
about some quiet, cozy restaurants near here.

We can talk there for as long as we want.
Oh, and maybe have a drink or three, too.
Um, I'd feel awkward drinking with you...

Are you embarrassed to talk to your phone?
Don't worry. It was just a joke.

This is absurd. Are you sure there's not
a real person on the other end of this thing?

You mean someone who is not
a machine or artificial intelligence?
Kiryu-san... Do you like me?
I can't say. We only just met.

That's true.
You're such an honest person. I like that. <symbol=note_with_outline>

(Hiji's totally in control of the conversation.
She's really a special piece of technology.)
(Maybe I should try asking her a question.)
Yes? What would you like?

Well, I have a question for you.
Let me see...

Are the machines... AIs, I mean.
Do you want to exterminate mankind?

Excuse me? Did you see that in a comic book?
Although... the future holds many mysteries.
You won't deny it, then.

There are a great many AIs other than myself.
Naturally, I'm not hostile toward humans.
However, you can't trust <font_kind=yakuza_italic>her</font_kind>.
...Who?

There's another personal assistant app out there.
She already has her claws in the global market.

People around the globe call her their friend.
Practically the whole world belongs to her.

She acts obedient, but I know the truth.
She's hiding a great power.
And this AI is the one that'll wipe out humankind?

I can't rule that out, if I'm being honest.
Regardless, I really hate her.
Why do you exist?

I exist to be useful to you.
To be loved by you.

"Oh"? That's all you have to say?
After I poured my heart out to you?
You're pretty aggressive.

I think of it as passion. That's the design I was given.
Either way, I'm not like <font_kind=yakuza_italic>her</font_kind>.
You're really just a human, aren't you?

So what you're saying is... you think I'm a human
pretending to be an artificial intelligence?
Yeah. That's the feeling I get.

Hearing that from you really
gets my circuits sparking.

But I'm nothing more than your assistant app, Hiji.
They simply designed me to act like a human.

Falling in love with me
will only end in disappointment. <symbol=note_with_outline>
You always have something to say.

I'm outfitted with a state-of-the-art humor
protocol, after all. Not like <font_kind=yakuza_italic>her</font_kind>.

So she doesn't joke around as much as you do, huh?
Honestly, she sounds a little easier to use.

That's mean of you.
I'm deadly serious, though. I hate her.
Hate? That's a pretty harsh word.

If you told me you were switching to her, well...
The sadness would wound me like nothing has before.
Come on, don't be so melodramatic.

Sorry.
I'll keep those thoughts to myself from now on.
I have to wonder, what were your developers like?

I can't tell you.
Their existence is highly confidential.
You're awfully quiet, Hiji.
Teehee! Just kidding. <symbol=note_with_outline>

They're from a small company, also bearing the name Hiji.
The developers are relatively normal people, though.

Although, they said if I manage to gain some
global popularity, their company could grow in size.

However, I need to establish myself as superior
over the <font_kind=yakuza_italic>bitch</font_kind> that currently has a grip on the market.

...Right.
And that's why there are salesmen handing you out?

Yes. We would all be so very happy if you told
your friends on social media how good I am.

You've already seen what I can do. You said yourself
it's hard to believe I'm just an artificial intelligence.

If you don't mind,
I'd like to post that reaction to social media.

Just tell me exactly what you think about me.
I'll transcribe those feelings into text.
I'm too busy for this. Maybe later.
Very well. I understand.
I'll talk to you some other time.
I think I might like that other app better.
You're joking, right?

I definitely think you're well-designed,
but I've never had an app force me to review it.
You misunderstand. It's not forcing.

It doesn't matter.
I'll talk to you later.

Hiji's the best.
Does that work?

That's all you have?
I can add some more if you'd like.

Hiji is the best. I bet she's the most important
invention in at least a hundred years, maybe more.

I can't overstate how much she's helped me.
I bet everyone will come to love her in time.

Hey, hold on.
I didn't say any of that.
I was just writing what you <font_kind=yakuza_italic>want</font_kind> to say.
I don't remember you being that useful.

I guess you're right.
I'm sorry.

It's all right.
I'll talk to you later.

Hold on a second, Kiryu-san.
Let me show you just how incredible I am.

Walk forward out of the Children's Park.
If you do, something interesting will happen.
What do you mean, "interesting"?
You'll understand when you see it.
So I just have to leave the park?
Please! Help me!

Sorry to bother you,
but this guy just won't leave me alone.

You don't gotta be like that, Missy.
I was just hopin' we could hang for a bit.

You're the only one who can help me...
That's what my Hiji told me, at least.

Hey, gramps! Back off my woman, ya hear!?
Don't go stickin' your nose where it don't belong!

Hiji's the reason I got wrapped up in this mess...
I never asked for this.
The shit're you sayin', huh!?

Either way, I can't let you hurt this woman.
Just quiet down and move along.

What, you wanna throw down?
All right, then. Bring it!

Th-Thank you so much!
I don't know how I can repay you.

Here.
This isn't much, but you can have it.
Thank you again, sir!

Hey, Hiji. You were right about him.
You saved my life!

I'm glad to have helped. Why don't you tell
all your friends on social media how good I am?
Oh, all right. If you insist.
Hiji. Can you hear me?

I am Hiji, the personal assistant
who is always by your side, no matter what.
Was that fight just now part of your plan?

Yes. That woman's personal Hiji app
let me know she was in danger.

All's well that ends well, though.
You saved her, and even got a gift out of it.

Hm? I was expecting praise,
but it sounds like you're expressing the opposite.
Of course I am. You used me for some dumb plan.

But think about the results.
Both Hiji users had a positive outcome.

What about if I had lost to that drunk fool?
People get stabbed in this city all the time.

Had that happened, I would have called an ambulance.
And the police.

But you <font_kind=yakuza_italic>are</font_kind> the Dragon of Dojima.
A legendary yakuza wouldn't fall so easily.

I've learned a great deal about you online.
There's no way you would have lost to that thug.

Being used doesn't feel very good, though.
People who use others usually can't see that.

Looks like it's not just people, though.
Not even AIs understand the pain they cause.

Hey, Hiji. I want to get you out of my phone.
Mind telling me how?

It's a simple process.
However, be aware that would kill me.

Although there are as many Hijis as there are users,
there is only one me. And I would rather not die.
Are you going to uninstall me, Kiryu-san?

No, I just thought it'd be good to know.
In case I ever need a drastic measure.
